# Third party material

One directory per source: its license text and a `SOURCE.md` naming the origin, the
version taken from, the copyright holder, and every file in this repository that carries
material from it, with what was taken. Update `SOURCE.md` in the same change that ports the
material.

A file that carries borrowed material starts with one notice naming the source, the copyright
holder and the license, and saying `Modified` when the text differs from the source. Nothing
else: the list of what was taken is in `SOURCE.md`, and version control keeps the changes.
